sv.title: AI-oro i New York påverkar handeln i Asien
sv.summary: Wall Streets oro kring AI-bolagen påverkar handeln i Asien. Det japanska tekniktunga investeringsbolaget Softbanks aktie rasar 15 procent, enligt CNBC.

en.title: AI worries in New York affect trading in Asia
en.summary: Wall Street's concern about AI companies is affecting trading in Asia. The shares of Japanese tech-heavy investment company Softbank plunge 15 percent, according to CNBC.
